chapter_name: HOT Category Puzzles – Flat + Floor Based

questions.question_text:
Eight people M,N,O,P,Q,R,S,T occupy two flats A and B on four floors; A is west of B; floors are numbered bottom-up. S is in Flat A on an even floor immediately above Q in the other flat. Q and R have one floor between them and occupy the same flat type. M is on Q’s floor and immediately below O. N and P share flat type; N is not on T’s floor; T is not below O.

Question: Who among the following persons stays on the topmost floor?
questions.explanation: Exhaustive placement of eight distinct people into the eight flat-floor slots under the written constraints yields one arrangement; T and P occupy floor 4, and among the options only T appears.
questions.source: PDF: HOT Category Puzzles Flat   Floor puzzles based 01 _ Class Notes.pdf.pdf; physical page(s) 5-7

questions.question_text:
Eight people A-H occupy four floors, two flats M (west) and N. F is on an odd floor, not N. A is immediately above F on another flat. One floor lies between A and E; nobody is west of E. C and G are on even floors, C above G. B and H share a floor; B is immediately below G’s floor. D and H are in different flats.

Question: Who among the following people lives on floor number first?
questions.explanation: The unique arrangement places G and B on floor 1; among the listed choices, B is present.
questions.source: PDF: HOT Category Puzzles Flat   Floor puzzles based 02 _ Class Notes.pdf; physical page(s) 4-6; printed Q1

questions.question_text:
Eight people A-H occupy four floors, two flats P (west) and Q. The note says 1 is not treated as a perfect square. G is on a perfect-square floor; one floor separates G and C. B immediately above C, in a different flat from G. One floor separates B and A; two floors separate A and F. H is above A but below D in a different flat from A. A does not live in flat P.

Question: Who lives in Flat Q on the top floor?
questions.explanation: The source’s two valid layouts differ only in a lower-floor placement; F occupies Flat Q on the top floor in both.
questions.source: PDF: HOT Category Puzzles Flat   Floor puzzles based 02 _ Class Notes.pdf; physical page(s) 7-9; printed Q6

questions.question_text:
Nine people Z,Y,X,W,V,U,T,S,R occupy three floors and three flats A,B,C (A west of B west of C). Clues: V is immediately above R; V is in flat B. Y is immediately above S; S is on an even-numbered floor. Nobody is west of Y. X is above U in different flats; X is not in B. T shares X’s flat number but not W’s. Z is immediately below T in flat B.

Question: Who among the following people lives on floor number first?
questions.explanation: The constraints force floor 1 to contain U, Z and R, matching option D. V is in flat B immediately above R; T is directly above Z, and X above U in a different flat.
questions.source: PDF: HOT Category Puzzles Flat   Floor puzzles based 02 _ Class Notes.pdf; physical page(s) 10-13; printed Q11
